author: RIP_Avicus
body:
If this has already been used by another server, then I apologise.
The idea is pretty much a league where there are no set games. For example:
We put all of the teams in a random order. The top 3 could look like this:
1: Bad Company
2: Cronus
3: Apollo
Apollo could then challenge Bad Company. If Apollo win, they will swap places with BC, but if Bad Company win, both teams stay where they are. To make it fairer, you can't turn down a challenge, but you can only challenge a team up to 3 places above you. It would take a bit of time, but eventually, we would get a good league going. It would also be good, because there would be no set dates and times to do the matches on. 
Opinions would be appreciated.
